note: A lexing set is not a grammar taxonomy: _KW says what may BEGIN A LINE and is used here only to assert coverage; the page's SHAPE comes from the docstring.

frame.statement: A .cml source document co-locates TWO layers. The LOGICAL declarations are what the Manifold is — what an agent sees over describe and the wire. The MAP clauses are how it binds to physical storage, and they are engine-visible ONLY: describe emits logical names, never a realized_by, a VIA bridge, a FROM table, or an expression. This is enforced, not intended — a standing insulation test asserts that physical identifiers never cross describe or the wire.

signatures: MANIFOLD <name> VERSION <n>              this engine artifact + its integer engine/cache revision
SOURCE_MANIFOLD <id> VERSION <semver>    OPTIONAL — the published governed Manifold this artifact was
notes: lowered from (columna#150 P0(b)). A distinct identity: a
stable id AND a semantic version, an atomic pair. Additive —
a legacy .cml omits it (no retained source identity). Never
-- "<text>"                     a DESCRIPTION (folklore) — LOGICAL, flows to describe + the wire
REJECT <table>.<col> "<reason>" an attested rejected/aside physical incarnation — PHYSICAL,
map-artifact-ONLY, NEVER crosses describe or the wire (§2b)

examples.gloss: the document header — a name and a version (both required)
examples.source:
MANIFOLD demo VERSION 1
UNIVERSE sales = store * day
LEVEL store = store_id BASE
LEVEL day = day BASE

examples.gloss: a population: the product of its base dimensions
examples.source:
MANIFOLD demo VERSION 1
UNIVERSE sales = store * day
LEVEL store = store_id BASE
LEVEL day = day BASE

examples.gloss: a coordinate. The `= <column>` is a MAP clause — engine-side, never crosses describe
examples.source:
MANIFOLD demo VERSION 1
UNIVERSE sales = store * day
LEVEL store = store_id BASE
LEVEL day = day BASE

examples.gloss: with an inline ATTR clause — also map-side (note ATTR is a CLAUSE of LEVEL, not a statement)
examples.source:
MANIFOLD demo VERSION 1
UNIVERSE sales = store * day
LEVEL store = store_id BASE
LEVEL day = day BASE
LEVEL region = region ATTR name = stores.region_name

examples.gloss: a functional roll-up lineage; braces required, and each hop carries its own VIA
examples.source:
MANIFOLD demo VERSION 1
UNIVERSE sales = store * day
LEVEL store = store_id BASE
LEVEL day = day BASE
LEVEL region = region
HIERARCHY location { store -> region VIA stores(store_id, region) }

examples.gloss: a quantity, aggregated. `FROM <table> AS <agg>(<expr>)` is a MAP clause
examples.source:
MANIFOLD demo VERSION 1
UNIVERSE sales = store * day
LEVEL store = store_id BASE
LEVEL day = day BASE
MEASURE revenue ON sales FROM tx AS sum(amount)

examples.gloss: a quantity defined from other measures — no map clause; it is pure logic
examples.source:
MANIFOLD demo VERSION 1
UNIVERSE sales = store * day
LEVEL store = store_id BASE
LEVEL day = day BASE
MEASURE revenue ON sales FROM tx AS sum(amount)
MEASURE orders ON sales FROM tx AS distinct(order_id)
DERIVED aov = revenue / orders

raw_block:
Grammar (statement-oriented; '#' comments; { } blocks):
    MANIFOLD <name> VERSION <n>              this engine artifact + its integer engine/cache revision
    SOURCE_MANIFOLD <id> VERSION <semver>    OPTIONAL — the published governed Manifold this artifact was
                                             lowered from (columna#150 P0(b)). A distinct identity: a
                                             stable id AND a semantic version, an atomic pair. Additive —
                                             a legacy .cml omits it (no retained source identity). Never
                                             derived from the MANIFOLD name/version.
    UNIVERSE <name> = <dim> * <dim> ... [WHERE <predicate>]
    LEVEL <name> = <column> [BASE] [ATTR <name> = <table>.<column> [, ...]]
    HIERARCHY <lineage> { <a> -> <b> VIA <table>(<a_col>, <b_col>) [-> <c> VIA ...] ; <path> ... }
    RELATE <a> <-> <b> VIA <table> [NOTE "<text>"]

    Any declaration may carry (case-demo b/d):
      -- "<text>"                     a DESCRIPTION (folklore) — LOGICAL, flows to describe + the wire
      REJECT <table>.<col> "<reason>" an attested rejected/aside physical incarnation — PHYSICAL,
                                      map-artifact-ONLY, NEVER crosses describe or the wire (§2b)
    MEASURE <name> ON <universe> FROM <table> AS <agg>(<expr>)
    MEASURE <name> ON <universe> FROM <table> VALUE <expr>
        [M_ANCHOR { <col>, ... }]
        [FAMILY { <agg> [: <tier>] [BLOCKED { <lineage>, ... }] ... }]
    DERIVED <name> = <expr>
